title: Products Never Sold
statement: Return the `name` of every product that doesn't appear in **any** order, in alphabetical order.
reference: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.product_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.name
wrong: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE i.quantity = 0 ORDER BY p.name
SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM order_items) ORDER BY p.name
